title: DualFrontLevel
description: Shape of the dual-front level JSONs under game/assets/levels/ (slice0_dual_front.json, night_tide_dual_front.json). Refreshed 2026-10-08 (T52): describes what SimulationCore.load_level_json (game/src/cpp/simulation_core.cpp) and LevelCatalog (game/scripts/data/level_catalog.gd) actually read. game/assets/levels/level_01.json is a legacy single-front leftover that the catalog skips and that does NOT conform to this schema (no landCount/seaCount). Keys marked informational are carried in the JSONs but consumed by no loader as of T52.

id.description: Level id. Used as GameSession.selected_level_id and the end_run level_id tag.

displayName.description: Shown in the main-menu LevelSelect and the dev-overlay level picker (read by LevelCatalog).

civPrimary.description: Informational as of T52: carried in the JSONs (e.g. Ming), consumed by no loader.

civSupport.description: Informational as of T52: carried in the JSONs (e.g. Portuguese), consumed by no loader.

buildPhaseSeconds.description: Read by SimulationCore.load_level_json via SimWorld.set_build_phase_seconds. If absent, the previous value is kept (SimWorld default 40.0).

victoryTimeSeconds.description: Read by SimulationCore.load_level_json via SimWorld.set_victory_time. If absent, the previous value is kept (SimWorld default 55.0).

enemySpawnIntervalSeconds.description: Informational as of T52: carried in the JSONs, consumed by no loader (wave timing comes from waves[].delaySeconds).

hqMaxHp.description: Read by SimulationCore.load_level_json and passed to SimWorld.reset_run. If absent, the run's current HQ max is kept (SimWorld default 100).

startingLandCurrency.description: Read by SimulationCore.load_level_json and passed to SimWorld.reset_run. If absent, the run's current land balance is kept (SimWorld default 14).

startingSeaCurrency.description: Read by SimulationCore.load_level_json and passed to SimWorld.reset_run. If absent, the run's current sea balance is kept (SimWorld default 14).

waves.description: Wave schedule. The loader falls back to a built-in 4-wave schedule only when the array is absent or yields zero waves; an empty array is therefore invalid here.

delaySeconds.description: Absolute combat-clock time at which the wave fires. Read by the loader via SimWorld.add_wave.

landCount.description: Raiders spawned on the land front. Required by LevelCatalog (first wave must carry landCount AND seaCount or the file is skipped as a legacy single-front template).

seaCount.description: Raiders spawned on the sea front. Required by LevelCatalog, same rule as landCount.

enemyCount.description: Deprecated legacy fallback: the loader uses it for landCount only when landCount is absent (level_01.json shape). New levels must use landCount/seaCount.

spawnPattern.description: Informational as of T52: carried in the JSONs (value lane), consumed by no loader (wave spawn is flow-driven when grids are live, lane fallback otherwise).
